# Vendored SentencePiece runtime

This directory is a source snapshot of Google's SentencePiece `v0.2.1`, commit
`31646a467d2051eb904e0b45de3a73e91fe1c1e3`. It is used only for deterministic
tokenization with a serialized model; training tools are excluded from the app
build. The upstream Apache-2.0 license is preserved in `LICENSE`.

Upstream: https://github.com/google/sentencepiece/tree/v0.2.1
